question: Shri Bhagawan Mahaveer Government Museum is located in ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Andhra Pradesh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Shri Bhagawan Mahaveer Government Museum** is located in Cuddapah, Andhra Pradesh.
 
• It was established in the year 1982.
 
• The museum showcases various artifacts, sculptures, and historical items significant to the region's cultural heritage.
 
• The museum is managed by the Department of Archaeology and Museums, Government of Andhra Pradesh.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Andhra Pradesh**

 
 
• Andhra Pradesh is a state in the southeastern coastal region of India.
 
• It is the seventh-largest state by area and the tenth-most populous state in India.
 
• The state has a rich cultural heritage, with historical sites, temples, and museums.
 
• Some notable places include the Tirupati Temple, Amaravati Stupa, and the Borra Caves.
 
 
 
• **Department of Archaeology and Museums, Government of Andhra Pradesh**
 
 
• This department is responsible for the preservation, conservation, and promotion of the cultural heritage of Andhra Pradesh.
 
• It manages various museums, historical sites, and monuments in the state.
 
• They conduct archaeological excavations and research to uncover and protect historical artifacts.
 
• The department also organizes exhibitions and educational programs to raise awareness about the state's cultural heritage.
 
 
 
• **Cuddapah**
 
 
• Cuddapah, also known as Kadapa, is a city in the Rayalaseema region of the Indian state of Andhra Pradesh.
 
• It is known for its rich history and cultural significance.
 
• The city has several historical landmarks, including temples, forts, and museums.
 
• It serves as an important cultural and educational center in the region.
